CREATE TABLE "public"."detail_peserta" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "nama" text NOT NULL,
  "peserta_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status_keluarga" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "detail_peserta_status_keluarga_check_29afe047" CHECK ("status_keluarga" IN ('KEPALA_KELUARGA', 'SUAMI', 'ISTRI', 'ANAK', 'ORANG_TUA', 'LAINNYA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."jenis_iuran" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "judul" text NOT NULL,
  "nominal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "organisasi_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "periode_iuran" text NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_akhir" date NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_awal" date NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "jenis_iuran_periode_iuran_check_cfb06890" CHECK ("periode_iuran" IN ('HARIAN', 'MINGGUAN', 'BULANAN', 'TAHUNAN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."keuangan" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenis_keuangan" text NOT NULL,
  "keterangan" text,
  "organisasi_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tanggal" date NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "keuangan_jenis_keuangan_check_6e72836c" CHECK ("jenis_keuangan" IN ('PEMASUKAN', 'PENGELUARAN'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."keuangan_detail" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "keterangan" text,
  "keuangan_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "nominal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "pembayaran_iuran_id" int4,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organisasi" (
  "activeAt" timestamptz,
  "alamat" text,
  "contact" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "kode" text NOT NULL,
  "nama" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "website" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."pembayaran_iuran" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenis_iuran_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "nominal_bayar" numeric NOT NULL,
  "nomor_transaksi" text NOT NULL,
  "organisasi_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "peserta_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "postedAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "tagihan_iuran_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_bayar" date NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "pembayaran_iuran_status_check_39761ed0" CHECK ("status" IN ('BERHASIL', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."peserta" (
  "alamat" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deskripsi" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "jenis" text NOT NULL,
  "kode" text NOT NULL,
  "nomor_kk" text,
  "nomor_rumah" text,
  "organisasi_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "qr_token" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tagihan_iuran" (
  "bulan" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jenis_iuran_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "keterangan" text,
  "nominal_tagihan" numeric NOT NULL,
  "nominal_terbayar" numeric NOT NULL,
  "nomor_tagihan" text NOT NULL,
  "organisasi_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "peserta_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "tahun" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_jatuh_tempo" date NOT NULL,
  "tanggal_terbit" date NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "tagihan_iuran_status_check_7f92ac25" CHECK ("status" IN ('BELUM_BAYAR', 'PARTIAL', 'SUDAH_BAYAR', 'OVERDUE', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."transaction_ledger" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "keuangan_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "nominal" numeric NOT NULL,
  "organisasi_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "system_details" text,
  "tipe" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "transaction_ledger_tipe_check_f766c1dc" CHECK ("tipe" IN ('DEBIT', 'KREDIT'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "contact" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "latestLogin" timestamptz,
  "name" text,
  "organisasi_id" int4,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_role_check_a8bee70d" CHECK ("role" IN ('USER', 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'))
)
